classification: public-train parent-world-model diagnostic; no reward, policy update, RL, dev/final, or submission

lineage.paired_endpoint_data: immutable passed v461 public train40/right15 endpoint200 dataset and final audit
lineage.appearance_parent: immutable frozen v169 release under the v463 symlink-aware closure contract

request_contract.explicit_right_formula: lower(instruction) contains 'right arm' and does not contain 'left arm'
request_contract.postclose_formula: finite arrays with history[-1,13] < 0.5 and all future[:,13] < 0.5
request_contract.canonical_no_transport_future: float32 copy of requested future; set every [:,7:13] exactly to float32 history[-1,7:13]; preserve [:,0:7] and [:,13] exactly
request_contract.canonical_baseline: one frozen-v169 prediction for canonical_no_transport_future, with the same context, history, instruction, and seed as the request
request_contract.training_seed: sha256('v466/1616/{episode}/{start}')[:8] little-endian modulo 2**31, identical for canonical and all comparator branches of one context
request_contract.runtime_seed: pass the caller-provided seed unchanged to the single canonical frozen-v169 call; A and D are deterministic and consume no RNG

target_decomposition.B0: float32 canonical frozen-v169 endpoint RGB at frame 7
target_decomposition.Yb: float32 simulator endpoint RGB for branch b

model_and_training.precision: bf16 autocast with float32 loss accumulation
model_and_training.folds: the immutable v461 episode-grouped 5 folds; 3 held-out right episodes per fold
model_and_training.appearance_head: one A head per fold, trained only on the fit-fold no_transport samples; no action inputs
model_and_training.dynamics_architecture: the same EndpointResidualUNet128FiLM architecture for all three heads
model_and_training.same_capacity_guard: all three D heads have byte-identical initial state, architecture, optimizer hyperparameters, batch schedule, context-group schedule, step count, precision, B0, A prediction, and targets; optimizers are independent
model_and_training.action_features: existing 223-dimensional request-only v458/v464 schema: normalized history+future 168, right6 endpoint delta 6, right6 anchor-relative path 48, postclose 1; arm tokens remain separate
model_and_training.context_only_features: zero the 168+6+48 explicit action values; retain postclose=1 and the same arm tokens
model_and_training.phase_shuffle_features: replace only explicit action values using the immutable within-episode donor map sorted by request-only phase score and float32 action SHA; retain postclose and arm tokens
model_and_training.dynamics_loss: L1(D,D*) + 0.25*gradient_L1(D,D*) + 0.5*L1((D_branch-D_no_transport),(D*_branch-D*_no_transport)) over the fixed five-branch context group
model_and_training.no_transport_guard: during training/evaluation/runtime, if requested float32 future[:,7:13] is array_equal to float32 history[-1,7:13] broadcast over 8 steps, bypass D and use an exact zero tensor
model_and_training.all200_after_s0_only: only after the immutable S0 receipt passes, train exactly one all200 A head for 50 steps and one all200 action D head for 50 steps using preregistered schedules

comparators_and_metrics.frozen_v169_comparator: for evaluation only, compute frozen-v169 outputs with each actual branch action, using the same branch-independent training seed; do not expose comparator RGB as a control input
comparators_and_metrics.control_endpoint: B0 plus the same frozen A prediction plus the corresponding D-control prediction
comparators_and_metrics.causal_pairing: retain the existing factual-anchored four paired differences per context for positive cosine and nonzero prediction metrics
comparators_and_metrics.mae_domain: endpoint RGB frame 7 only, averaged in float64 over RGB pixels and then samples
comparators_and_metrics.fold_pass_semantics: unchanged from v458/v464; a fold passes only when every preregistered fold-level ratio and causal gate passes

early_stop.two_failed_folds: hard stop immediately after a second failed fold because passing_folds_min=4 is then mathematically unreachable
early_stop.failure_behavior: terminate, bounded join, kill/join the full process group; atomically write a failure receipt; never train all200 or package

runtime.baseline_return_semantics: return the frozen-v169 prediction for the original requested future as baseline for diagnostics, while internally using the separately computed canonical B0 for A+D
runtime.left_and_gate0: for non-explicit-right or non-postclose requests, return the original requested-action frozen-v169 output bitexact
runtime.frames_0_to_6: always bitexact to the original requested-action frozen-v169 output
runtime.frame_7: modify only for explicit-right and strict-postclose requests that pass the gate
runtime.no_transport: D is exact zero; endpoint may contain only the preregistered appearance correction A
runtime.batch_equivalence: batched and scalar APIs must be bitexact for identical requests
forbidden: reward imports or runtime reward calls
action generation, selection, clipping, or policy modification

closure_and_audit.v461: bind final receipt, selection, generation report, all 410 immutable dataset files, and their SHA256 values
closure_and_audit.v169: reuse the passed v463 symlink-aware logical inventory: lexical link path, readlink text, resolved target constrained to the joint artifact root, target SHA, no cycles or duplicate resolved targets
closure_and_audit.sources: bind prepare, trainer, runtime, packager, launcher, this contract, all schedules, and their SHA256 values
closure_and_audit.checkpoint: bind feature schema, B0 formula, A/D decomposition, no_transport exact-zero guard, training scope, step=50, precision, schedule SHA, source SHA, preregistration SHA, and closure digest
closure_and_audit.release: atomically package exactly the all200 A and action-D checkpoints, runtime, preregistration, S0 report, training report, contract, and manifest
static_tests: three D heads same initialization and schedules

cost_estimate.gpu: one RTX 5090; expected peak below the observed v464 12522 MiB and hard-capped at 28672 MiB
cost_estimate.v169_cache_order: compute requested-action comparator and canonical-no_transport baseline sequentially in microbatches of 4, never concatenate both populations; unload frozen v169 and empty the CUDA cache before training A/D heads
cost_estimate.cpu: taskset CPUs 0-11, OMP 6, other BLAS thread pools 1
cost_estimate.expected_wall_seconds: 300-420 for S0, including canonical and frozen branch-comparator v169 caches; hard stop at 480
cost_estimate.fastest_falsification: first fold metrics become available atomically; stop after the second failed fold; no all200 work before full S0 PASS
